title: Moving House 8-Week Planner
method: Live web search + page-level inspection of the listings themselves (external, read-only, $0 spend). Each entry cites the live URL, the displayed price and a verbatim snippet from the page. Pages that rendered no price are recorded as NOT_READ rather than guessed.
scope_note: The 8-week moving-plan category is a commodity printable: the median observed price is roughly $7, the top single-product price is $12 (18 fillable pages), and the only $29 point is a 3-product bundle. Our planned $29.00 for one plan + one tracker is not supported by this evidence.

competitors.name: Moving Checklist Printable PDF | 8-Week Moving Planner (Momentum Templates Co.)
competitors.notes: A single-page 8-week checklist. Sets the floor for the exact 8-week idea we planned.
competitors.quote: "Moving Checklist Printable PDF | 8-Week Moving Planner $2.99 ... 1-page Moving Checklist (PDF) ... Organized into an 8-week timeline"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: Moving House Checklist, English + Deutsch (bordatonico)
competitors.notes: 2-page A4 print-ready PDF with 6-8 weeks / 4-5 weeks / 1-2 weeks phases plus a First Night Box. Price shown in EUR.
competitors.quote: "Moving House Checklist (English + Deutsch) $2.24 ... 2 pages, A4, print-ready PDF"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: Moving Checklist Bundle (PrintableUtils)
competitors.notes: 10 pages across 4 files (A4 + US Letter, colour + B&W) on sale from $3.90. Bundled-but-cheap is the norm here.
competitors.quote: "Price: $2.72 Original Price: $3.90 ... 4 pages starting from 8 weeks prior to moving day ... = 10 Pages in total"

competitors.notes: 14 pages: 8-week countdown with 20 tasks/week, box inventory log, utility transfer tracker, 20-item address-change checklist, budget tracker. Closest single-file shape to ours at a mid price.
competitors.quote: "Moving Planner: 8-Week Countdown & Box Inventory System $7 ... 8-week countdown: 20 tasks per week from Week 8 down to moving day ... 14 pages"

competitors.name: Moving & New Home Planner, 18 pages, fillable + printable (mastertech8)
competitors.notes: 18 pages as BOTH a fillable PDF and a printable PDF, zipped: mover quote comparison on 13 points, 48-box inventory, 17-place change-of-address, deposits/refunds tracker. The depth bar for a $12 product in this category.
competitors.quote: "Moving & New Home Planner ... $12 ... What is inside (18 pages) ... Mover and truck quotes: three quotes side by side on 13 points ... Box inventory (2 pages, 48 boxes)"

competitors.notes: A 3-product bundle (home records book + new-home checklist + 8-week checklist) at $29.00 - the only observed $29 point in the category, and it is a bundle, not a single planner.

demand_signals.value: the $2.72 bundle and $14 pack are long-lived listings with steady review counts; exact counts not captured on the market page

observed_span_usd.cluster_note: Single-product prices $2.24-$12; $14-$17 for packs; $29 only as a multi-product bundle.
